verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Dagster exposes an MCP *server* (Dagster+ MCP) so external AI agents can query/act on Dagster, and an AI 'skill' for coding agents to build Dagster projects — this is the reverse direction. There is no evidence that Dagster itself acts as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers so it can consume their tools within its pipelines/assets.
